summary: Framework Python để xây dựng, chạy và quản lý các nền tảng AI agent một cách dễ dàng.
usecases: Rapid prototyping and deployment of autonomous AI agents for task automation.
Building multi-agent systems for complex workflow orchestration.
Integrating AI agents into existing developer tools or internal business workflows.
ideas: Combine with vector databases to enable Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) capabilities for agents.
Develop a visual agent builder UI on top of the framework for non-technical users.
Deploy agents as serverless functions for scalable, on-demand AI execution.
